verdict: PASS (with 1 environment-blocked: live cross-app signal VALUES not verifiable in this headless harness)
environmentCaveat: CRITICAL: in this headless Playwright session the base44 DATA API returns 404 'App not found' for EVERY entity — measured: User 404, LifestyleItems 404, DailyStory 404, HoroscopeReading 404, Programs 404. Because base44.auth.me() 404s, uid is null, so loadCrossApp never even queries MealPlans/CompanionState (they are uid-guarded) and Programs 404s. Result: crossApp stays empty and the three data-backed signals render their HONEST plain-doorway fallback. This is the documented 'apps-null / App not found' baseline of the sandboxed verify browser, NOT a confirmed piece-F defect. The signal-building code is correct per source (LifestyleEliteShell.jsx:931/933/934) and the fallback contains NO faked numbers. The real signal values (Tonight: <dish> / <name> is in bloom / <title> · N days) must be confirmed in a real logged-in browser or the base44 Preview device-toggle.

assertions.expected: 5 cross-app cards with REAL signals: journal 'Today's prompt…'; cook 'Tonight: <dish>'; garden '<name> is in bloom'; session '<title> · N days' (no minutes); community 'lighter side…'. None faked.
assertions.got: journal='Today's prompt, a fresh page' (OK, static); community='The lighter side · pull up a chair' (OK, static); cook='Plan tonight's dinner' (FALLBACK — data API 404); garden='What's grown lately' (FALLBACK); session='A short guided thing' (FALLBACK). Data-backed values UNVERIFIABLE here: all base44 entity endpoints 404 in this harness (auth.me 404 -> no uid -> MealPlans/CompanionState never queried; Programs 404).
assertions.note: BLOCKED BY ENVIRONMENT, not a confirmed defect. 2 static signals correct; 3 data signals show the honest fallback (no faked numbers). Real values need a real-browser / base44-Preview check. Code contract is correct.

assertions.got: cook -> https://femwells.com/Nutrition ; session -> https://femwells.com/ProgramsHub (landed on the real 'Your programmes' page). Other three targets per source: journal->/Journal, garden->/Garden, community->/Community?room=lighter (window.location.assign).

assertions.name: 6-console-no-new-errors
assertions.expected: no NEW errors beyond User.me baseline; specifically NO MealPlans/Programs/CompanionState entity-method errors from loadCrossApp
assertions.got: NEW errors: NONE. No 'MealPlans/Programs/CompanionState is not a function' — loadCrossApp fails gracefully (try/catch + per-call .catch). Baseline only: 'N.entities.User.me is not a function', 'App not found', apps/null 404s, connect_error/socket, 'Programs elite init failed: App not found'.
assertions.note: loadCrossApp swallows the 404s cleanly — no crash, no new console error.
